entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING
entities.description: A state in the network where an EPS bearer context activation has been initiated towards the UE.

entities.name: EPS bearer context activation
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure to activate an EPS bearer context towards the UE.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that initiates the EPS bearer context activation.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: The User Equipment that is the target of the EPS bearer context activation.

relations.description: The BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING state is associated with the ongoing EPS bearer context activation procedure.
The network initiates the EPS bearer context activation procedure.
The EPS bearer context activation procedure is directed towards the UE.
